Back up and move your progress

Save your progress, your own words and your pictures to one file. Load that file on another device to carry everything across, or to get it back after clearing the browser.

Automatic marking

Let Claude mark your typed answers, like the Claude version does. It uses your own Anthropic API key, kept only on this device. Each answer costs a tiny fraction of a penny.

  1. Go to console.anthropic.com and sign up or sign in. This is separate from your Claude app account.
  2. Under Billing, add a small amount of credit, and set a monthly spending limit if you like.
  3. Under API keys, tap Create key, name it "Word Trainer" and copy it. It starts with sk-ant-.
  4. Paste it below and tap Save and test. Do the same on each device.

Sync between your devices

Keep your progress, own words and pictures the same on your tablet, phone and PC. Everything is stored in a private file in your own GitHub account.

  1. Open this GitHub page (sign in if asked).
  2. Set Expiration to No expiration. Leave only gist ticked.
  3. Tap Generate token at the bottom, then copy the code that starts with ghp_.
  4. Paste it below and tap Connect. Do the same on each device.
